adapter_boundary: Typed imports and compact local ticketCard; no external channels, deployment tools or Session registration.

tool_identity.text: export const tool = <S extends z.ZodType>(definition: Tool<S>): Tool => definition as unknown as Tool

acknowledgement.text:
export const AcknowledgementSchema = z.string().trim().min(1)
  .refine(text => wordCount(text) <= IM_WORDS, `An acknowledgement has at most ${IM_WORDS} words (Chinese uses word segmentation); write one short sentence.`)

worktree_name.text: export const WorktreeNameSchema = z.string().max(32).regex(/^[a-z]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+){0,3}$/, 'Use 1–4 short English words in lowercase kebab-case, at most 32 characters').describe('Meaningful short English ticket name, e.g. fix-plan-color. Translate Chinese titles into English; no Chinese, pinyin or generic ticket names. 1–4 lowercase words in kebab-case, at most 32 characters.')
